obligations.requirement: Each supported local intention has an explicit semantic preimage and emits a new typed compensation through the submit port.
obligations.oracle: Literal fixtures assert exact inverse payloads for AddStroke, SetTransforms, DeleteObjects, SplitStrokes, and AddEraseMasks.
obligations.acceptance: Focused history test passes for all five families without deriving expected payloads from the implementation.

obligations.requirement: Undo and redo allocate fresh operation identities and preserve prior operation facts.
obligations.oracle: Submit capture asserts source kUndoRedo, unique non-zero OperationId values, and unchanged previously captured operations.
obligations.acceptance: Two-step undo/redo sequence emits exactly two new operations and restores the original semantic payload.

obligations.requirement: Rejected/conflicted compensation does not move History state or permit partial compensation.
obligations.oracle: Rejecting submit port leaves undo availability intact and emits no redo availability.
obligations.acceptance: Retry succeeds with the same exact compensation semantics and history moves only after acceptance.

obligations.requirement: History has no snapshot/store mutation or sequence rewind surface.
obligations.oracle: Public API exposes only intention recording plus typed Operation submit; scope audit confirms no semantic store/runtime mutation.
obligations.acceptance: Scope evidence contains only authorized interaction/history and Aegis paths.
